name: notion_search
description: Search your Notion workspace by keyword. Returns matching page/database titles, IDs, and types to locate content quickly.

page_size.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

name: notion_get_page
description: Get a Notion page by ID. Returns full properties, metadata, and content structure for reading or editing.

page_id.description: Notion page ID (UUID format, with or without dashes)

name: notion_get_database
description: Get a Notion database schema by ID. Returns all properties, field types, and configuration to understand structure.

database_id.description: Notion database ID (UUID format, with or without dashes)

name: notion_query_database
description: Query a Notion database with filters and sorting (e.g., status='Done', sort by date). Returns matching rows with property values.

page_size.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

name: notion_list_pages
description: List all accessible pages in your Notion workspace. Returns titles and IDs to discover available content.

page_size.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results
